timestamp_basis: Verification observations recorded during this run; not a historical user-message timestamp.
scope: Local production-code composition for remaining Matrix intake, consent, attachment preparation, session dispatch, existing provider router/Critic, durable final-delivery intent, bounded work, retries, restart and Stop. Existing transport, design and canonical SDD artifacts preserved.

fixes.result: Durable leased Matrix ingress dispatches the actual application planner/consultation executor after consent; an accepted event is deduplicated before subscription work.

A connection-owned MySQL lock prevents concurrent workers. Uncertain attempts require explicit continuation; normal committed completion is not rerun after restart. Old leaders cannot cancel a replacement generation.
Clarification/native replies retain logical session, complete prior discussion and immutable settings. Only replies to the current session's original inputs or accepted outbound events may join it.
Normal finalization uses closeSession instead of stopSession, preserving the already committed final outbox item. Explicit Stop still fences late output and queued delivery.

Unconfirmed attachment bytes are encrypted in existing MySQL KV rows before ACK, expire after 15 minutes and require event-bound consent. The adapter supplies private native Codex image inputs or bounded text-layer PDF extraction. Unsafe/expired bytes are not substituted by metadata.
Whole unsafe inputs/provider outputs are rejected before canonical recording or delivery. Confirmation does not enable runtime secrets, external actions or arbitrary tools.

Fast/balanced/thorough policies bound specialists to 2/3/5 with one mandatory critique-revision cycle. A 540-second attempt limit asks for explicit continuation before the 10-minute boundary; no automatic additional subscription run.

Publication and input decisions are serialized without holding provider network calls under a DB transaction. Costs cannot swallow a final answer; Stop during snapshot preparation cannot orphan a session; readiness loss becomes an explicit interruption.

Cross-message aggregate attachment bytes are checked before persistence; state mutations are validated before commit. Oversized amendments are discarded without poisoning the job, and Stop remains usable.

execution_policy.basis: Bounded implementation defaults within explicitly authorized resolution of execution limits. This is not a new owner-approved canonical SDD/design baseline.

workflow_and_database.scope: 15 durable-worker/reply/control regression tests plus 6 parameterized outbox and MySQL connection-lock boundary tests; in-memory/scripted adapters.

observations: Real production application worker invokes the actual head intake, consultation runner, specialists, selected Astra/xhigh Critic and head synthesis using fake RPC and simulated DB/transport.
No provider turn before consent; 7 expected turns across 5 isolated contexts; no Claude acquisition when Codex is selected.
Final registrar session is closed, final message remains pending for the existing durable Matrix sender and replay does not add provider turns.

pdf_and_image.scope: Real unpdf extraction and pinned Codex 0.153.1 schema/private-file handling without authenticated model calls. No live model interpretation evidence.

pipeline.scope: Declared source, prompt, baseline and reference integrity; not full semantic quality or release acceptance.

research.use: Primary documentation for turn image/localImage inputs; supported fields additionally verified against pinned 0.153.1 generated native schema.
Primary library documentation for pure-JS bounded text extraction; dependency pinned to 1.8.1.
Primary PDF.js API documentation for text extraction and document inspection.

known_limits: No Published GoDaddy end-to-end test, real MySQL concurrency/restart test, live model call or actual Matrix delivery/read receipt was run in this change. Local final-delivery intent is not live receipt proof.
Scanned/image-only PDFs, OCR, charts requiring visual PDF interpretation and protected/active PDFs are unsupported and rejected. Text-layer extraction is not full ordinary-PDF acceptance.
Per-document owner confirmation and heuristic secret detection cannot prove arbitrary image/text data contains no sensitive information. Full sensitive-document handling acceptance is not claimed.

The 45-second system waiting notice is not a guaranteed first specialist reply within 30 seconds or a 90-second automatic specialist replacement protocol. Full timing and usability gates remain unverified.
Expired/unreadable attachment recovery requires New task and resending safe source files; no silent refetch, indefinite media retention or automatic replacement.
Historical archive, JIT credential, private-path artifact and broader release evidence gaps remain outside this local slice. No unit is newly accepted.
